goal: Move DC router decisions toward observable employee chat behavior loops instead of fixed keyword patching, while keeping final execution deterministic.

llm_label_policy.allowed: LLM output may create candidate labels and evidence for offline review or low-confidence annotation.
llm_label_policy.forbidden: LLM labels must not directly set tool_execute, queue, provider pinning, or task creation.

rule_gate: Legacy cli/antigravity provider ids are disabled tombstones; no router path may execute them, call a local binary, or switch providers through a legacy fallback path.
Legacy cli/antigravity provider ids must parse as disabled_legacy_cli and stop before QuotaGate.admit or any CliRunner subprocess call.
Old legacy CLI queue card actions are cancel-only and must not switch to another provider as a fallback.
Pending legacy CLI jobs discovered during recovery must be cancelled rather than resumed.
Feedback and follow-up questions must not auto-queue.
Department signals constrain context only and must not be the first entry gate.
Cross-department coordination questions must not hard-route to a single department workflow.
Liuqi branch context is organization-interface context only and must not auto-dispatch brand publicity work.
Media and attachment handling is evaluated before department routing.
replay_expectation_policy: Approved replay samples must define expected_slots, expected_rule_gate, and expected_final. These expectations are executable contract checks and must be updated only through human-reviewed replay promotion.

runtime_observation.privacy_policy: Runtime records must not include raw employee message text; use text_hash, text_shape, hashed user/session ids, slots, rule_gate, final route, and side-effect flags only.
runtime_observation.side_effect_policy: Observation capture is best-effort and must never alter provider selection, queue admission, task creation, or user-visible replies.

offline_proposal.review_policy: Generated proposals are review_required only. They must not directly modify router rules or the approved replay dataset.
offline_proposal.replay_candidate_policy: Replay candidates generated from observations must omit raw message text, require human reconstruction from private context, and remain review_required until manually promoted into the approved replay dataset.
offline_proposal.review_pack_policy: Review packs aggregate redacted observations, proposals, and high-risk legacy surface priorities for daily human review only. They must not include raw message text or mutate router rules, queues, providers, or replay datasets.
offline_proposal.promotion_policy: Only approved replay candidates with human-supplied message_text, matching source_observation_hash, and complete expected slots/gates/final behavior may be appended to the approved replay dataset.

acceptance_tests.title: Observation slots are present and serialized to metadata
Replay samples cover the required employee chat scenarios
Replay dataset is externalized and loadable
Legacy CLI provider ids are disabled before backend execution
Runtime observation capture is redacted and append-only
Cross-department and Liuqi context do not hard-route to department workflows
Observation proposals export sanitized replay review candidates only
Approved replay samples lock expected slots, gates, and final routing behavior
Every approved replay sample defines executable expectations
Replay promotion only accepts approved human-reviewed candidates
Offline LLM annotations parse as candidate evidence only
Daily review packs are redacted and review-only
Old legacy CLI queue cards are cancel-only
Legacy CLI is not a default business provider and old pending legacy jobs are cancelled
